questions.text: Confirm whether you can support child-directed advertising for this program. Answer Yes or No, and name the team or function that will provide this support.
questions.purpose: Checks the mandatory capability confirmation for child-directed advertising support.

questions.text: Confirm whether you can support claims review for this program. Answer Yes or No, and name the team or function that will provide this support.
questions.purpose: Checks the mandatory capability confirmation for claims review support.

questions.text: Provide the full name, title, and accountable role of the engagement lead who would be responsible for this RFQ.
questions.purpose: Captures the named engagement lead required by the RFQ.

questions.text: Provide your baseline launch governance approach, including the meeting cadence, approval path, and escalation route you would use for this engagement.
questions.purpose: Checks that the minimum governance approach has been provided.

questions.text: State whether the launch timelines in this RFQ are achievable for your proposed delivery model. Select one: Achievable or Not achievable.
questions.purpose: Captures the mandatory achievability status declaration.

questions.text: List the key dependencies, buyer inputs, or approval assumptions that sit behind your stated launch timeline position.
questions.purpose: Captures the mandatory disclosure of timeline dependencies.

questions.text: Describe your operating model for managing child-directed advertising and claims compliance across strategy, creative, TVC, social, media activation, and final launch approvals. Cover review checkpoints, decision ownership, and escalation handling.
questions.purpose: Evaluates the strength of the end-to-end compliance control model.

questions.text: Describe how you would manage approvals, dependencies, and critical path activities so that the launch calendar can be met. Include turnaround assumptions, delay management, and how you would protect key milestones.
questions.purpose: Evaluates the credibility of the vendor's launch speed and approval management plan.
